# Lapiz Blue

> Lapiz Blue General Trading LLC is a building materials supplier in the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah), authorised reseller of Mapei, and distributor of Laticrete, Weber, AkzoNobel (Dulux), Profilpas, Montolit and Hilti. Named Outstanding Construction Material Wholesaler in the 2026 Dubai Local Awards.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.lapizblue.com/): company overview and brands
- [About](https://www.lapizblue.com/about): leadership, group companies, certificates, awards
- [Construction chemicals distributor in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/construction-chemicals-dubai): what Lapiz Blue supplies, brands it is authorized for, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah branches, FAQ
- [Brands](https://www.lapizblue.com/brands): every brand and product line stocked
- [Mapei](https://www.lapizblue.com/brands/mapei): tile adhesives, grouts, waterproofing, technical data sheets
- [Blog](https://www.lapizblue.com/blog): guides and product news
- [Contact](https://www.lapizblue.com/contact): phone +971 4 885 5257, WhatsApp, branch addresses
